messages.ko: 새해복 많이받으세요~~~ 다들 설연휴 안전하고 즐겁고 행복하시길 ~~🤍🤍
messages.en: Happy Lunar New Year~~~ I hope everyone has a safe, fun, and happy Lunar New Year holiday~~🤍🤍

messages.ko: 연휴니까 하고싶었던거 해보고싶었던거 먹고싶었던거 다 해볼수있기를 바랄게여
messages.en: Since it's the holiday, I hope you get to do everything you've wanted to do, try everything you've wanted to try, and eat everything you've wanted to eat.
I'll be taking it easy during the Lunar New Year holiday too.
I'll be going to my grandma and grandpa's house
and eating lots of delicious food.
ㅎㅎㅎ
Above all,
stay
safe.
Drive safely, watch out for cars, and watch out for people.
Watch out for dogs, and be careful with fire.
There might be dogs if you're visiting the countryside,ㅎㅎ
What am I supposed to do if I miss you during the Lunar New Year holiday?ㅠㅠ
Then just see me!
Whenever
there's a break while I'm talking with the adults,
I'll message you for a little bit.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
You'll have to put on a little talent show when you go back to your hometown~
I'll do my cutest performance,
and get twice as much New Year's money.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹ
Is this the famous Jeong Hayeon who's popular wherever she goes?~
Oh, but both of my younger cousins absolutely adore me.
They really love
asking me to play with them.

messages.ko: 나도 하연이랑 같이 마크 할 수 있는데........
messages.en: I could play Minecraft with you too........
These days I'm building an amusement park in Minecraft.
It's going to be really huge!!

messages.ko: 마크 시작한지 별로 안됐는데 뭘 해야될지 모르겠어..괜히 산거 같애ㅜ
messages.en: I only started playing Minecraft recently, and I don't even know what to do... I feel like I bought it for nothing.ㅜ
I'd love to teach you.
If you played with me, you'd probably want to play every day.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹ
I'll show you the amusement park once it's finished.
Well then, have a warm and filling Lunar New Year holiday.
Catch up on all the sleep you've missed,
and enjoy lots of games too.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
I'll message you if I have some free time!!
Haranghae💝
